scope: Bounded native check history across recheck, compaction and client restart; public release paused
problem: The observed-check ledger keyed a command and workdir to one record, so a later zero exit replaced its earlier failed result. A restarted handoff could omit that failed-then-rechecked lineage.
change: Retain one previous failed receipt per check key, including native message ID, time, exit code and allowlisted diagnostic. Keep raw command arguments and output outside the private tracker. A later pass or stale state displays the earlier failure separately from current unresolved checks and from application acceptance.

validation.plugin_regression: PASS: same check fails, then exits zero, compacts, restarts and exposes the prior failed message and later stale observation; legacy tracker loading also passes

limits: No native model trial or installed-owner candidate was run for this change. This preserves a bounded provenance receipt; it does not make model status answers accurate, prove Task12 browser acceptance, qualify a higher context tier, or close endurance and second-account inference gates.
